title: Pickup
description: A driver arrives at the hospital or surgery center, logs the team, item type, and quantity, and captures a timestamped pickup photo.

title: Chain of Custody
description: Every handoff is recorded automatically — driver, route, facility, team, and quantities — building a complete audit trail in transit.

title: Delivery
description: On arrival, the driver logs delivery condition and captures photo proof. No signatures, no ambiguity — just a verified record.

title: Verified
description: The receiving rep sees pickup and delivery photos, quantities, and timestamps instantly, and can request office pickup in one tap.
